t:
No part of any appropriation contained in this Act shall remain available for obligation beyond the current fiscal year unless expressly so provided herein.

This Act may be cited as the “Foreign Assistance and Related Agencies Appropriation Act, 1968.”

fable.w: This section only limits the availability of appropriated funds to the current fiscal year and gives the Act's short title. There is no tempting participation reading: it has no consultation, hearing, rulemaking, advisory body, or right to sue, and no party outside the federal government is involved in any federal decision.
fable.s: No part of any appropriation contained in this Act shall remain available for obligation beyond the current fiscal year unless expressly so provided herein.

qwen_block.w: This section is a standard appropriations clause limiting the availability of funds to the current fiscal year. It does not involve any consultation, coordination, or decision-making process with parties outside the federal government. There are no advisory boards, public hearings, or requirements for outside input mentioned.
qwen_block.s: No part of any appropriation contained in this Act shall remain available for obligation beyond the current fiscal year unless expressly so provided herein.

opus.w: This section limits appropriated funds to the current fiscal year and gives the Act's short title. It sets up no comment period, hearing, advisory body, consultation with outsiders, or right to sue. The phrase "Foreign Assistance" is part of the Act's name, not a process involving outside parties.

qwen_chat.w: This section is a standard fiscal provision limiting the availability of appropriated funds to the current fiscal year. It does not establish any process for consultation, coordination, or input from parties outside the federal government. The citation clause also does not involve participation.
qwen_chat.s: No part of any appropriation contained in this Act shall remain available for obligation beyond the current fiscal year unless expressly so provided herein.
qwen_chat.b: Tempting-but-wrong reading: One might argue that because this is an appropriations act for "Foreign Assistance," it implicitly involves foreign governments or NGOs, thus triggering participation. However, the text itself contains no procedural requirements for consultation, coordination, or input from any outside party. It is purely a fiscal limitation and a citation clause.
